en-US.title: CritterPass: Group Trips
en-US.subtitle: Plan, vote and split together
en-US.description:
Every trip starts in the group chat. Most of them end there too. CritterPass gives your crew one place to pick where to go, plan the days, share the costs and keep the trip moving once you land, with a local guide who happens to be an animal.

SWIPE TO PICK
Everyone swipes through the shortlist. The tally fills live and the winner is settled in minutes, not weeks.

ASK THE LOCAL
Every destination has its own guide, with its own colour and voice. The guide drafts a day-by-day plan for the whole crew and answers anything by text, voice or camera. Rain on Thursday? It proposes a swap.

PLAN TOGETHER
One plan the whole crew can move around. Drag anything to a new slot and the rest of the day shifts to make room, for everyone at once.

SPLIT IT
Log an expense or scan the receipt, split it however you like, and settle up. Nobody keeps a spreadsheet, and nobody has to be the one who asks for money.

EVERY BOOKING, EVEN WITH NO SIGNAL
Flights, stays and tickets sit in one wallet that works offline, with a nudge when it is time to leave.

YOU CAN'T BUY THEM. YOU HAVE TO GO.
When you land somewhere new, that place's local hatches onto your pass. Stay a while and more of them turn up. Critters only come from being there.

START A CREW, OR JOIN ONE
CritterPass is free to download and plan with. Start a crew, or join one with the code a friend sent you.

PASS+ AND TRIP BOOST
Pass+ is an optional subscription, monthly or yearly, that adds extra perks on top of the free app. Trip Boost is a one-off purchase for a single trip and the whole crew on it. Prices are shown in the app and the store in your currency before you buy. Pass+ renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your account settings. Terms: https://critterpass.app/legal/subscription-terms

ABOUT THE GUIDES
The guides are AI. Their plans and answers are written by AI, and facts they found on the web carry their source. Check anything important, like opening hours or entry rules, before you rely on it.

Privacy: https://critterpass.app/legal/privacy
Terms: https://critterpass.app/legal/terms
